architecture: 55% Random Forest (120 trees) + 45% Extra Trees (120 trees)
calibration_offset: +5.30 Percentile (CAP4 closing to CAP1 opening shift)
data_version: MHT-CET CAP 2022-2026 Master Dataset (397,152 verified rows)
limitations: Special micro-quota categories (PWD, DEF, ORPHAN) contain low single-seat volume and experience higher year-over-year volatility.
CAP1 cutoffs historically open higher than later rounds (CAP2, CAP3, CAP4).
Forecasts represent probabilistic estimates based on historical seat allotment patterns and approved intake, not admission guarantees.
